Categorical log score in nats: higher is better. Whiskers are 95% seed-bootstrap intervals; seed is the independent unit.
Reliability is a descriptive control diagnostic. Every finite bin is drawn on common 0–1 axes. The dark dotted identity marks perfect calibration.
Oracle, uniform and confident-wrong controls check score and reliability behavior. They do not establish deployment calibration or universal robustness.
